# Training cluster characterization


## Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(scabcd)
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(readr)

proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))

# Outcome data
cbcl_nausea_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_nausea_train.csv"))
cbcl_vomiting_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_vomiting_train.csv"))
cbcl_dizzy_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_dizzy_train.csv"))
cbcl_overtired_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_overtired_train.csv"))
cbcl_sleeping_more_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_sleeping_more_train.csv"))
cbcl_sleeping_less_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_sleeping_less_train.csv"))
cbcl_depress_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_depress_train.csv"))
cbcl_anxiety_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_anxiety_train.csv"))
cbcl_attention_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_attention_train.csv"))
cbcl_aggressive_train <- read_csv(proc_path("cbcl_aggressive_train.csv"))

# The SNF meta-clustering outcome rows we are interested in characterizing
top_om_rows <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_03_08_top_om_rows.csv"))

top_om_rows
```

## Characterize CBCL measures

```{r}
cluster_df1 <- get_cluster_df(top_om_rows[1, ]) # The top solution of MC2
cluster_df2 <- get_cluster_df(top_om_rows[2, ]) # The top solution of MC1
cluster_df3 <- get_cluster_df(top_om_rows[3, ]) # The stable full soln in MC2


# Make a joined dataframe for further characterization
cluster_outcome_list1 <- list(
    cluster_df1,
    cbcl_nausea_train,
    cbcl_vomiting_train,
    cbcl_dizzy_train,
    cbcl_overtired_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_more_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_less_train,
    cbcl_depress_train,
    cbcl_anxiety_train,
    cbcl_attention_train,
    cbcl_aggressive_train)

cluster_outcome_list2 <- list(
    cluster_df2,
    cbcl_nausea_train,
    cbcl_vomiting_train,
    cbcl_dizzy_train,
    cbcl_overtired_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_more_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_less_train,
    cbcl_depress_train,
    cbcl_anxiety_train,
    cbcl_attention_train,
    cbcl_aggressive_train)

cluster_outcome_list3 <- list(
    cluster_df3,
    cbcl_nausea_train,
    cbcl_vomiting_train,
    cbcl_dizzy_train,
    cbcl_overtired_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_more_train,
    cbcl_sleeping_less_train,
    cbcl_depress_train,
    cbcl_anxiety_train,
    cbcl_attention_train,
    cbcl_aggressive_train)

characterization_df1 <- merge_df_list(cluster_outcome_list1)
characterization_df2 <- merge_df_list(cluster_outcome_list2)
characterization_df3 <- merge_df_list(cluster_outcome_list3)


# P-values
cbcl_ord_reg(characterization_df1, bonferroni = TRUE)
cbcl_anova(characterization_df1, bonferroni = TRUE)

cbcl_ord_reg(characterization_df2, bonferroni = TRUE)
cbcl_anova(characterization_df2, bonferroni = TRUE)

cbcl_ord_reg(characterization_df3, bonferroni = TRUE)
cbcl_anova(characterization_df3, bonferroni = TRUE)




# DF1
## S by anova and ord reg:
nausea1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_nausea")
vomiting1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_vomiting")
dizzy1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_dizzy")

## S by anova or ord_reg:
anxiety1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_anxiety")

## NS by anova and ord reg:
sleeping_more1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_sleeping_more")
sleeping_less1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_sleeping_less")
overtired1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_overtired")
aggressive1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_aggressive")
attention1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_attention")
depress1 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df1, "cbcl_depress")


# DF2

vomiting2 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df2, "cbcl_vomiting")
overtired2 <- cbcl_bar_chart(characterization_df2, "cbcl_overtired")

nausea3

clean_plot(nausea3)

clean_plot <- function(plot) {
    cleaned_plot <- plot +
        ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") +
        ggplot2::xlab("") +
        ggplot2::ylab("")
    return(cleaned_plot)
}

grid.arrange(
    clean_plot(nausea1),
    clean_plot(vomiting1),
    clean_plot(dizzy1),
    clean_plot(overtired1),
    clean_plot(sleeping_more1),
    clean_plot(sleeping_less1),
    clean_plot(depress1),
    clean_plot(anxiety1),
    clean_plot(attention1),
    clean_plot(aggressive1)
)


grid.arrange(
    clean_plot(nausea2),
    clean_plot(vomiting2),
    clean_plot(dizzy2),
    clean_plot(overtired2),
    clean_plot(sleeping_more2),
    clean_plot(sleeping_less2),
    clean_plot(depress2),
    clean_plot(anxiety2),
    clean_plot(attention2),
    clean_plot(aggressive2)
)

grid.arrange(
    clean_plot(nausea3),
    clean_plot(vomiting3),
    clean_plot(dizzy3),
    clean_plot(overtired3),
    clean_plot(sleeping_more3),
    clean_plot(sleeping_less3),
    clean_plot(depress3),
    clean_plot(anxiety3),
    clean_plot(attention3),
    clean_plot(aggressive3)
)
```
